# T-201 generic assertion effects: structural-readonly import identity.
# The lgo module sl declares a qualified interface (a readonly method
# obligation), so its facts member carries a structural Readonlys record
# and the Go-importer clone path applies. A Go wrapper w re-exports the
# nominal (alias + a maker returning sl.Qual); the Go main imports w
# before sl, the order that captures sl as a placeholder before the
# structural clone replaces packages[sl]. The Go-importer preload must
# hydrate positively-classified structural dependencies first (member
# present, decodable, structural), so both import orders share one
# canonical sl.Qual: the cross-spelling assignments type-check and the
# program runs. RED without the preload: "cannot use w.Make() (value of
# type sl.Qual) as sl.Qual" -- identical spellings, distinct nominals.
# The nominal declaration-only diamond is logos_assert_diamond.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOTMPDIR=$WORK/tmp
mkdir $WORK/tmp

cd m
logos build -o m$GOEXE .
! stderr 'cannot use'
exec ./m$GOEXE
cd ..

cd m2
logos build -o m2$GOEXE .
! stderr 'cannot use'
exec ./m2$GOEXE
cd ..

# Neither direct import of this Go consumer is the lgo nominal owner.
# Inspect the actual retained compiler importcfg, not helper output.
cd cache
logos build -work -x -o cache$GOEXE .
exec ./cache$GOEXE
cd ..
go run inspect.go $WORK/tmp
stdout '^structural owner available$'

# Change only the readonly obligation (erased from PKGDEF), leaving the
# public Go signatures and wrapper source unchanged. A cached successful
# consumer must not survive the transitive owner fact change.
cp sl/sl.ordinary sl/sl.lgo
cd cache
! logos build -o cache$GOEXE .
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
cd ..

-- sl/go.mod --
module example/sl

go 1.27

-- sl/sl.lgo --
package sl

type Token struct{ Text string }

type Qual interface {
	const Name() Token
}

type Good struct{}

func (g Good) Name() Token { return Token{Text: "good"} }

type StoreBox[T any] struct{ V T }

func (b StoreBox[T]) Self() StoreBox[T] { return b }

func New() Qual {
	b := StoreBox[Qual]{V: Good{}}
	return b.Self().V
}

-- w/go.mod --
module example/w

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- w/w.go --
package w

import "example/sl"

// Alias re-exports the qualified interface nominal.
type Alias = sl.Qual

func Make() sl.Qual { return sl.New() }

-- m/go.mod --
module example/m

go 1.27

require (
	example/sl v0.0.0
	example/w v0.0.0
)

replace example/sl => ../sl

replace example/w => ../w

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example/w"
	"example/sl"
)

func main() {
	var q sl.Qual = w.Make()
	var a w.Alias = q
	if a.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("diamond mismatch")
	}
}

-- m2/go.mod --
module example/m2

go 1.27

require (
	example/sl v0.0.0
	example/w v0.0.0
)

replace example/sl => ../sl

replace example/w => ../w

-- m2/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example/sl"
	"example/w"
)

func main() {
	var q sl.Qual = w.Make()
	var a w.Alias = q
	if a.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("diamond mismatch")
	}
}

-- contract/go.mod --
module example/contract

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- contract/contract.lgo --
package contract

import "example/sl"

type Want interface {
	const Name() sl.Token
}

-- cache/go.mod --
module example/cache

go 1.27

require (
	example/contract v0.0.0
	example/sl v0.0.0
	example/w v0.0.0
)

replace example/contract => ../contract
replace example/sl => ../sl
replace example/w => ../w

-- cache/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example/w"
	"example/contract"
)

func main() {
	var q contract.Want = w.Make()
	if q.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("transitive structural owner mismatch")
	}
}

-- sl/sl.ordinary --
package sl

type Token struct{ Text string }

type Qual interface {
	Name() Token
}

type Good struct{}

func (g Good) Name() Token { return Token{Text: "good"} }

type StoreBox[T any] struct{ V T }

func (b StoreBox[T]) Self() StoreBox[T] { return b }

func New() Qual {
	b := StoreBox[Qual]{V: Good{}}
	return b.Self().V
}

-- go.mod --
module example/inspect

go 1.27

-- inspect.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	found := false
	err := filepath.WalkDir(os.Args[1], func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || entry.IsDir() || entry.Name() != "importcfg" {
			return err
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		text := string(data)
		if !strings.Contains(text, "packagefile example/w=") || !strings.Contains(text, "packagefile example/contract=") {
			return nil
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
			if archive, ok := strings.CutPrefix(line, "packagefile example/sl="); ok && archive != "" {
				if _, err := os.Stat(archive); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				found = true
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if !found {
		panic("Go consumer importcfg lacks transitive structural owner")
	}
	fmt.Println("structural owner available")
}
